t: The Fortress Trade Extra Long Pile Roller Sleeve is specifically engineered for efficient painting of rough and textured masonry surfaces. Its extra-long microfibre pile and open texture design ensure a high paint load capability, delivering superb coverage across exterior walls, render, and brickwork. This durable 9" roller sleeve provides excellent paint release with minimal splatter, making it an ideal choice for trade professionals seeking a reliable solution for demanding outdoor painting projects and renovation work.
b: Open Texture Delivers High Paint Load Capability
Minimises Splatter for Cleaner Work & Finish
